title.zh: 晚间工作场景植物饮料

summary.en: A botanical flavor concept for the end of a workday, with caffeine exposure, taste and processing questions addressed before a formula is selected. Not a substitute for rest.
summary.zh: 面向工作日尾声的植物风味饮料概念；选定配方前先解决咖啡因暴露、口味与加工问题，不能替代休息。

brief.en: Begin with the occasion, market, intended adult audience and whether any tea-derived caffeine is acceptable. Explore a restrained botanical profile rather than promising wakefulness, recovery or sleep benefits. The initial route can exclude tea if the caffeine brief cannot be met.
brief.zh: 先明确场景、市场、拟定成年受众及是否接受茶来源咖啡因。探索克制的植物风味，而非承诺清醒、恢复或助眠效果。若无法满足咖啡因需求，初步路线可排除茶成分。

selection.en: Screen a documented low-caffeine green-tea grade only if residual caffeine can be measured and accepted. Reishi is a separate, optional bitter botanical direction, conditional on species, fungal part, local use status and safety review. Neither ingredient is a validated combination or a mandatory formula.
selection.zh: 仅在残留咖啡因可测量并被接受的条件下筛选有文件支持的低咖啡因绿茶规格。灵芝属于另一个可选的苦味植物方向，须审核物种、真菌部位、当地使用地位及安全性。两者既不是已验证组合，也不是必须采用的配方。

validation.en: Plan blinded sensory comparisons for bitterness and astringency; measure caffeine in the selected prototype rather than inferring it from a name. Compare pH, turbidity, sediment, color and marker retention before and after the proposed heat cycle. Agree storage conditions, time points and rejection criteria before testing.
validation.zh: 计划对苦味与涩感进行盲法感官比较；对选定原型检测咖啡因，而非根据名称推断。比较拟定热处理前后的 pH、浊度、沉淀、颜色与标志物保留。试验前商定储存条件、取样节点与拒收标准。

packaging.en: A dark-green can is a visual direction, not a confirmed filling format. Check coating compatibility, seam integrity, oxygen control and the partner's validated process before selection. The name AFTER HOURS is illustrative copy only; trademark and label clearance remain project tasks.
packaging.zh: 深绿色罐装仅是视觉方向，并非已确认灌装形式。选型前须检查内涂层相容性、卷封完整性、氧控制及合作方已验证工艺。AFTER HOURS 仅为示意文案，商标与标签核查仍属项目任务。

title.en: Unsweetened botanical tea for everyday routines

summary.en: A simple everyday tea concept without added sweeteners. Ingredient sugars, caffeine, preparation instructions and label eligibility are reviewed separately; no weight-loss positioning.
summary.zh: 不添加甜味剂的日常植物茶概念。原料糖、咖啡因、冲泡说明及标签适用性分别审核，不定位为减重产品。

brief.en: Choose a hot or cold preparation ritual, target market and dry sachet versus ready-to-drink format. Unsweetened means the concept adds no sweetening ingredient; it is not a verified sugar-free or zero-calorie claim. Do not include stevia or monk-fruit sweetener in this brief.
brief.zh: 选择热饮或冷饮习惯、目标市场及干式袋装或即饮形式。本概念的无甜味剂表示不添加甜味配料，并不代表已经验证的无糖或零热量声称。本需求不包含甜菊糖苷或罗汉果甜味剂。

selection.en: Compare documented green-tea extract grades and, as a separate botanical variation, a goji material with complete sugar and carrier disclosure. Fruit powder, juice solids and purified polysaccharides are not equivalent. A dry extract blend also needs dispersibility review; it is not automatically a leaf infusion.
selection.zh: 比较有文件支持的绿茶提取物规格；另可探索完整披露糖与载体的枸杞材料。全果粉、果汁固形物与纯化多糖并不等同。干式提取物混合物仍需检查分散性，不能自动视为茶叶浸泡物。

validation.en: Plan preparation trials across agreed water temperatures, volumes and steeping or stirring methods. Assess sediment, taste and color; check moisture, packaging barrier and microbial risks for dry blends. For an RTD version, establish an independent thermal and shelf-life study. Review the full composition before any nutrition claim.
validation.zh: 在商定水温、水量及浸泡或搅拌方式下计划制备试验。评价沉淀、口味与颜色；干式混合物须检查水分、包装阻隔性及微生物风险。即饮版需单独制定热处理与货架期研究。任何营养声称前先审核完整成分。

packaging.en: An ivory carton and sachet family illustrates a daily preparation format. Confirm food-contact compliance, moisture barrier, seal performance, preparation copy and artwork ownership with selected suppliers. Sachet size, serving quantity and carton count are intentionally unassigned.
packaging.zh: 米白色盒装与小袋系列用于示意日常冲调形式。与选定供应方确认食品接触合规、防潮、封口性能、制备文案及设计权属。小袋尺寸、每份量及每盒数量均未设定。

summary.en: A crisp botanical taste direction for a still or sparkling beverage. Refreshing describes sensory intent, not a stimulant effect or a guaranteed physiological benefit.
summary.zh: 适用于无气或气泡饮料的清爽植物风味方向。清爽描述感官意图，不表示刺激作用或保证生理益处。

brief.en: Define a dry tea-forward or lightly sweetened taste, still versus sparkling format, acid profile and intended consumption occasion. Compare sweetened and unsweetened prototypes separately. Decide the target market before choosing any concentrated extract or sweetener grade.
brief.zh: 明确偏干茶感或轻甜口味、无气或气泡形式、酸度风格及消费场景。分别比较有甜味与无甜味原型。选择浓缩提取物或甜味剂规格前先确定目标市场。

selection.en: Green tea is a candidate for the botanical profile, with caffeine and catechin specifications reviewed independently. Monk-fruit or stevia grades are optional alternative sweetening routes, not a required blend. Check glycoside identity, production route, carrier composition and market permission for each candidate.
selection.zh: 绿茶可作为植物风味候选，咖啡因与儿茶素规格须分别核查。罗汉果或甜叶菊规格是可选且相互替代的甜味路线，并非必须混合。对每个候选核查糖苷身份、生产路线、载体组成及市场许可。

validation.en: Compare sweetness onset, lingering notes, astringency, aroma and carbonation in the actual acid system. Plan clarity, foaming, dissolved-gas retention, color and microbial-control checks through the proposed filling cycle. Sensory prototypes are not evidence of shelf-life or health effects.
validation.zh: 在实际酸度体系下比较甜味起始、后味、涩感、香气与碳酸感。计划在拟定灌装流程中检查澄清度、起泡、溶解气体保留、颜色与微生物控制。感官原型不是货架期或健康作用证据。

packaging.en: An amber bottle is a visual option to discuss alongside cans or other formats. Confirm pressure rating where carbonated, closure integrity, light transmission, process compatibility and transport tests. No bottle source, capacity, MOQ or filling slot is promised.
packaging.zh: 琥珀色瓶是可与罐装等形式并列讨论的视觉选项。含气产品须确认耐压等级，并核查封口完整性、透光、工艺相容性及运输试验。不承诺瓶子来源、容量、起订量或灌装档期。
